name: Delaunay Flux
recipe: An animated Delaunay triangulation: a set of drifting points is retriangulated so the triangle mesh continuously flexes, edges flip, cells breathe — a living low-poly web. Distinct from a static gradient mesh: the TRIANGULATION itself changes. Default COLORFUL: triangles filled by centroid-position hue (iq palette) with bright edges, OR wireframe glow. Luminance ~0.2-0.5, fills frame.
kernel: ~40-120 drifting points in S (move on K.t, wrap); each frame compute a Delaunay triangulation (Bowyer-Watson, small N) and draw filled/stroked triangles hued by centroid; points drift so edges flip continuously. Rebuild each frame (N small enough).
style: stained-poly (default, centroid-hue fills + bright edges). Also: wireframe (glow edges on black), gem (faceted jewel), blueprint (white mesh on blue), ink (named mono).

name: Lichtenberg Figure
recipe: A Lichtenberg figure: a fractal dielectric-breakdown burn branches across the frame from a seed, forking into ever-finer feathery tendrils (like captured lightning in acrylic / frost on glass), GROWING then resetting. Distinct from a lightning bolt: it's a persistent fractal BURN pattern that accretes. Default COLORFUL: glowing violet/white branches with a hot core on near-black (or amber burn on wood). Luminance ~0.15-0.4, spreads to fill frame.
kernel: DBM/growth: maintain a growing tree of charged nodes in S; each step add branches at points weighted by field gradient (or simple biased random branching from tips), draw new segments with two-pass glow into a PERSISTENT buffer; reset/regrow on K.section. Growing tendrils = motion.
style: electric (default, violet/white glow on black). Also: acrylic (captured-lightning cyan), woodburn (amber on timber), frost (white on blue), ink (named mono).

name: Munching Squares
recipe: The classic PDP-1 'munching squares': plotting points where (x XOR y) < t as t counts up produces mesmerizing nested-square patterns that pulse, interleave and cascade — pure bit-pattern hypnosis. Extend with XOR/AND/mod variants that morph on K.section. Default COLORFUL: the bit-value mapped through a vivid cyclic palette so the squares shimmer in rainbow moire, luminance ~0.2-0.5, edge-to-edge.
kernel: per-pixel (coarse buffer <=200): compute a bit-function of (x,y,frame) e.g. ((x^y)+K.t*rate)&mask or (x*y>>k)^..., map the low bits through a cyclic palette LUT; the threshold/parameter animates on K.t so the pattern munches continuously. Cheap, upscale.
style: rainbow-xor (default, cyclic palette). Also: phosphor (green), amber-crt, thermal, mono (named, b/w bit-field).

name: Celtic Knotwork
recipe: Interlaced Celtic knotwork: continuous over-under woven bands threading through a grid of crossings into endless interlocking loops, with the characteristic breakline walls. The weave slowly scrolls / re-threads on K.t so the knot perpetually reconfigures. Default COLORFUL: multi-hue bands (gradient along the cord) with dark gaps giving the over-under illusion, on a rich ground. Luminance ~0.2-0.5, edge-to-edge.
kernel: cache a grid of crossing tiles + breaklines (seeded) in S; draw the interlaced bands as thick rounded strokes with a darker outline and alternating over/under at each crossing (draw unders first, then overs); hue-gradient along the cord; slow K.t scroll / periodic re-thread. Rebuild on seed.
style: illuminated (default, gold/jewel bands, dark ground). Also: neon-weave (glow cords on black), stone-carve (grey relief), tartan (multi-color), ink (named mono, black knot on cream).

name: Droste Spiral
recipe: The Droste effect: a conformal (log-polar) mapping makes the image recurse into itself along a logarithmic spiral, an infinite self-similar zoom twisting inward forever (the classic Escher 'Print Gallery' twist). The spiral rotates/zooms continuously on K.t. Default COLORFUL: a bright banded/tiled source pattern wound into the Droste spiral, hue rotating on K.t; luminance ~0.2-0.5, fills frame.
kernel: per-pixel (coarse buffer): map screen (x,y) to log-polar (log r, theta), apply the Droste twist (shift by rotation that scrolls on K.t, wrap the log-radius by the zoom period), sample a synthetic banded/checker/noise source at the wound coordinates through a palette. Continuous K.t zoom+rotate = motion.
style: spectral-spiral (default, hue-cycling bands). Also: escher-tile (checker), neon-vortex, monochrome-op (named), oil-slick (iridescent).

name: Symmetry Wallpaper
recipe: Generative wallpaper-group symmetry: a random motif is replicated under one of the 17 plane symmetry groups (mirrors, glides, 3/4/6-fold rotations) tiling the plane into an ornate seamless pattern; the motif and symmetry morph on K.section. Default COLORFUL: a richly-hued organic/geometric motif repeated into a kaleidoscopic wallpaper, luminance ~0.25-0.55, edge-to-edge.
kernel: render a seeded motif (noise/curve blobs) once into a small tile buffer, then tile it across the frame applying the chosen group's symmetry operations (reflections/rotations via transforms); motif drifts on K.t, group switches on K.section. Fills frame seamlessly.
style: jewel-ornament (default, rich motif). Also: art-nouveau (organic curves), islamic (geometric star), psychedelic (high-sat), woodblock (named mono-ish).

name: Living Stipple
recipe: Weighted-Voronoi (Lloyd relaxation) stippling: thousands of dots migrate to represent a slowly-morphing density field, clustering dark and spreading light like a living pointillist engraving — the dots continuously flow as the target image drifts. Default COLORFUL: dots hued by the underlying field (or classic black ink on cream), the density field a drifting fbm/portrait-like gradient. Luminance ~0.2-0.55, fills frame.
kernel: ~1500-2500 stipple points in S; each frame nudge each point toward the local density-weighted centroid (approx Lloyd) of a drifting fbm density field, draw as small dots sized/hued by local density. Field drifts on K.t so dots perpetually flow/re-cluster.
style: ink-stipple (default, black dots on cream). Also: spectral (field-hued dots), gold-dust (warm on black), blueprint (white on blue), neon.

name: Spirograph Roulettes
recipe: Spirograph hypotrochoid/epitrochoid roulettes: a small gear rolls inside/around a big gear tracing looping multi-petal rosettes; several nested pens of different ratios and hues draw simultaneously, the gear ratios drifting on K.t so the rosettes bloom, densify and re-pattern. Default COLORFUL: multi-hue translucent roulette curves (additive) layering into luminous moire flowers on dark, luminance ~0.15-0.45, fills frame.
kernel: draw 2-4 hypotrochoid curves x=(R-r)cos t + d cos((R-r)/r t), y=... as dense polylines with two-pass glow, each a different R/r/d + hue; ratios drift slowly on K.t so the figures morph; long enough t-range to close/fill. Additive layering.
style: neon-rosette (default, multi-hue glow). Also: gold-guilloche (metallic), pastel-spiro, blueprint (white on blue), ink (named mono).

name: Kolam / Sona Loops
recipe: South-Indian kolam / sona drawings: smooth continuous loops thread AROUND a regular grid of dots (pulli), never crossing them, weaving symmetric endless-knot patterns that grow to fill the frame. Draw the loops progressively (as if being drawn) and periodically re-generate a new pattern. Default COLORFUL: bright white/chalk or multi-hue loops around glowing dots on a dark ground (rangoli color). Luminance ~0.2-0.5, edge-to-edge, symmetric.
kernel: place a dot grid in S; generate smooth looping curves that orbit each dot (rounded diamond/loop tiles chosen per cell so they connect into continuous strands), draw with a smooth stroke + glow; progressive reveal on K.t (draw length grows), regenerate on K.section. Symmetric layout.
style: chalk (default, white loops + glowing dots on dark). Also: rangoli (multi-hue), neon, gold-thread, ink (named mono, black on cream).

name: Ferrofluid Spikes
recipe: FIX of a version that rendered as a MURKY dark grid — the Rosensweig SPIKE array didn't read. Re-author so the ICONIC SPIKE FIELD is unmistakable: a regular hex array of distinct TALL spikes (sharp conical peaks) that rise from a black fluid, each with a BRIGHT specular tip/rim highlight so the spikes pop in 3D relief; spikes pulse in height, migrate and merge as field strength varies on K.t. Make peaks clearly separated and bright-tipped, not a flat noisy surface. Default COLORFUL: oil-black fluid, iridescent (petrol/violet/gold) rim highlights on the spike tips; luminance ~0.18-0.4, fills frame with the spike array.
kernel: hex array of spike centers in S (heights pulse/jitter on K.t, field on K.section); build a coarse height field = sum of sharp radial bumps (peaked, e.g. exp or 1/(1+r^2)^k), shade by height + gradient with a strong specular highlight near each peak tip; upscale. Peaks must be tall/separated with bright tips.
style: petrol (default, black fluid + iridescent spike tips). Also: chrome (liquid-metal), lava (glowing orange peaks), mercury (silver), ink (named mono, black spikes/white tips).
